name: National Scheduled Tribes Finance Development Scheme (NSTFDC)
description: Concessional term loans and marketing support for economic empowerment of Scheduled Tribe families.
benefit: Term loans up to Rs. 50 Lakh at low interest rates from 4% to 6%

name: Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Central Pension Scheme
description: Mandatory retirement savings and employer contribution pension for formal sector salaried employees.
benefit: 12% matching employer contribution with assured 8.25% interest and lifelong pension

name: Employees State Insurance (ESIC) Medical & Sickness Scheme
description: Comprehensive health, sickness, and disability social security for formal workforce earning under Rs 21k/mo.
benefit: Full free hospitalization and sickness wage reimbursement

name: Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rozgar Yojana (ABRY)
description: Subsidy to incentivize formal job creation by paying employee and employer EPF contributions.
benefit: Government covers 24% EPF wages for new employees in registered firms

name: Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana for SC/ST
description: Hostel construction and residential accommodation grant for students belonging to SC and ST communities.
benefit: Free boarding and lodging in high school and college hostels

name: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme for SC Patients
description: Direct financial aid for specialized surgical treatment of serious illnesses for low income SC patients.
benefit: Medical treatment aid up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh for cardiac, renal and cancer surgery

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Children of Parents Engaged in Unclean Occupations
description: Educational assistance to children whose parents are involved in hazardous cleaning and sanitation.
benefit: Annual scholarship grant of Rs. 3,500 to Rs. 8,000 with book grant
